title: Cardi B Moves to Shut Down Viral AI Series ‘Cardi B Is the Nanny’
key_facts: In late September, AI-generated clips showed Cardi B as the star of a 1990s-style version of 'The Nanny', using her likeness and an AI-generated version of her voice.
The project is linked to the creator Old Era Films/Old Era TV, and viewers praised it; some said they would watch a real remake.
Shine My Crown reported on 30 Sep that Cardi's legal team ordered the creator to remove the series.
The creator reportedly called it a joke and tribute, then confirmed the videos would be taken down.
The Black Effect Network podcast 'I'll Do It Myself' also covered the dispute on 30 Sep and said the account announced the videos were coming down.
EURweb says no verified lawsuit or court complaint connected to the series has surfaced; it is a reported takedown demand, not a court win.
In 2023 Cardi B found an AI-generated ad using imagery and a voice resembling hers to promote a financial offer.
quote_evidence: Shine My Crown reported Sept. 30 that Cardi's legal team ordered the creator to remove the viral series.

why_it_matters_hint: It shows a celebrity moving against a popular AI fan production that used her face and voice, with no court case so far.

notes: Single outlet relaying other outlets (Shine My Crown, a podcast); Cardi B's team has not been quoted. Underlying news is from 30 Sep, before 2 Oct 2026.
